text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's the final straight!! Who will 
claim victory in this clash of the 
century?!

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Gooooo-!!" "Do your best!!!" "You can win 
this!!" "Gooooooo!!!!" "Win it, 
Loves-chaaaan!!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (――I can hear it. Everyone's voices...!!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(We really are connected! With 
everyone!!!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: With every single ounce of my love...!!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Loves Only You!! Loves Only You 
takes the lead!!! Loves Only You, Loves 
Only You!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And they cross the finish line in first 
place!!!!

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, *hic*... Loves-chan... You've 
really... grown into someone amazing...!!

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"Time to celebrate, celebrate!!" "Love is 
the strongest!!" "Can't stop crying" 
"Let's all raise a toast!" "It's a 
festival!!" "Thank you for the greatest 
run!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: In this race, I...――

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's right. So stand taller and carry 
yourself with pride!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ai-san...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Damn it...!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...I was completely set on winning today! 
I didn't slack off on a single thing. I 
was perfect...! And yet, it wasn't 
enough...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The strength you displayed is something I 
don't possess... It was far beyond 
anything I could have ever imagined...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: So that's what your love is...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I will definitely win...! So 
please, race with me again!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? D-Does that mean—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That means I can't afford to take a long 
break. Time to retrain from scratch right 
now...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I'll see you in the next 
race. ――Congratulations on your win today.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Almond Eye-san, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: For embracing my love—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(...Thank you for staying stronger than 
anyone else, Ai-san.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
――And now, Trainer-kun, please say a few 
words to your precious trainee♪
choice_data_list: That was the most lovey-dovey ever!!!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
――And now, Trainer-chan, please say a few 
words to your precious trainee♪
choice_data_list: That was the most lovey-dovey ever!!!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Aha♡ —That goes for you too, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Aha♡ —That goes for you too, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Loves Only You, congratulatiooons! That 
was an amazing ruuun!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That was insanely thrilling!! Thank you 
for such an inspiring raceーー!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone! Thank you so much for your 
support!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Supported by so many precious bonds, I 
was able to stand on this stage today...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"It is precisely because in these trying 
times... we shared our pain with those we 
cherish and fought together—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I am certain... that I have reached a 
level of running that I could never have 
achieved on my own...!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
To spread the preciousness... and strength 
of those bonds even further...! I will 
continue to take on every challenge!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's all! Love me♡ Love you♡ This was 
Loves Only You!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Thunderous applause surrounds Loves 
Only You. As if offering a blessing to 
that very love—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――...A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, we decided to just take the rest 
of the day off, drinking tea and taking it 
easy~♪”

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Chill vibes are nice~" "Tough race, gg!" 
"Still, thx for the stream!" "Yuru-love~" 
"Thanks for your hard work today!" "*hands 
tea*"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"‘Thanks for streaming anyway.’ Fufu♪ As 
if I wouldn't stream!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Because my connection with everyone is 
something that could never, ever be 
missing! ♡"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Please keep loving me, forever and 
always.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna send lo~ts and lots of love to 
everyone too!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Support with love!" "Help with love~!" 
"So precious" "Cherish the bond" 
"Supporting for life!" "Comrades!" 
"Everyone in the comm is family" "So 
lovely~"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The bond between Loves Only You and 
the commu-members will continue to remain 
strong from here on out."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as long as that bond exists, she will 
be able to make her love shine endlessly. 
Even reaching a world that no one has ever 
known—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ――Trainer-kun! Look, look!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ――Trainer-chan! Look, look!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Look, comments are coming in from 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you as always, Bridge-san!" "We're 
counting on you!" "I'm so glad it was 
you." "You better make her happy, 
alright?! ;;;;"

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for all your hard work!" "Thank 
you for connecting us with Loves-chan!" 
"Sending love to our bridge too!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "...Fufu♪ You're so loved, aren't you♡"
choice_data_list:
...I'll keep returning this love, now and 
always.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Loves Only You's Trainer. As the bridge 
connecting her and her community members. 
I will continue to devote myself to her 
and the commu-members.
choice_data_list:
—Because that's the love that only I can 
give.

—Because that's the love that only I can 
give.

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
“Praise Kakeru~!” “That's our girl!” “Look 
how much you've grown!” *heart throb* 
“That's our Trainer!” “Love has arrived!!”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Aah—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I really am so blessed.
